src: eight dihedral orientations of the filled rectangle crop s, carrying singleton internal marker colors
dst: external singleton marker layout d for the same marker colors
match_cond: normalized positions of s.marker colors == normalized positions of d by color
transform: return the matched oriented crop; discard background and external markers
grid_shape: tight crop of the matched rectangle orientation
symbol_instructions: external marker pixels define the target relative marker layout, selecting the crop orientation
